capabilities: Detect monospace fonts installed on the system
Customize source mode font, size, weight, line height, and colours
Fall back to theme defaults for individual settings
Expose a .source-mode-raw class for further CSS customization
disambiguation: Only styles source mode; it does not change how Live Preview or reading mode look.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.9.14+; README notes mobile font selection is limited to system fonts and some features may be unavailable on mobile. Includes troubleshooting guidance.
intentEvidence: Source Mode Styling enhances Obsidian's source mode editor by applying monospace fonts and customizable styling
problem: Obsidian's default source mode retains most visual formatting and variable-width fonts, so it looks nearly identical to Live Preview instead of like plain text.
summary: Applies monospace fonts and customizable font, colour, and spacing styles to Obsidian's source mode editor for a raw-text look distinct from Live Preview.
